narrative.intro: Nelnet Servicing shows $294M in contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Nelnet Servicing received 8 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $36.8M. Nelnet Servicing obligations are down 25.9% year over year. Looking back across the last six fiscal years, Nelnet Servicing obligations rose from $145M in FY21 to a peak of $407M in FY24, then eased to $397M in FY25 and to $294M in FY26. Nelnet Servicing current-year totals are partial, covering fiscal year to date, so the FY26 figure is not a full-year total. Nelnet Servicing award counts and average award sizes reflect contract obligations, while some tables in the source list total contract values instead of obligations. Nelnet Servicing contractors, programs, or agencies are not enumerated in the provided figures, and the dataset does not detail which specific contracts are expiring soon. Use the listed fiscal-year obligations and the headline metrics to compare Nelnet Servicing to other vendors or to track changes over time within the same reporting framework.
